title: BRGC: Bounded Role-Aware Graph Context for relation prediction
description: Code, analysis scripts and results accompanying the paper "How Much Graph Context Does Knowledge Graph Relation Prediction Need?". Contains the frozen model implementation used for every reported run, the parameter-free endpoint baselines, entropy diagnostics and bootstrap scripts, and (v1.1.0) the revision notebooks and results: paired per-query significance tests, endpoint-uncertainty grouping, TransE/RotatE/CompGCN baselines, multi-seed selector and schema ablations, and dataset-bias diagnostics.
